g.text: Assigning a wallet to agents, and switching it off (requirement 6; C3 step 2, C8, C13, C17; banda-integration answer 1)
Mara's agent file must also name the connection
may be on for one agent; the account argument then
lists only Mara's own wallets, by label.
They share the balance, so they share the cap. Recipients, labels and Deny are the
wallet's; Always binds (wallet, agent, recipient): Sancho's first payment to Ana asks,
and its card offers "Always pay Ana for Sancho too" (R-7, OD-1).
Signed, Sent and Included are unchanged: past the burn point
row: payment Idle · call [not wallet_usable] → Refused (Call)
